title: Cryptogram
desc: Decode eight encrypted quotes one letter at a time with hints, strikes, and a running score.

title: Word Scramble
desc: Unscramble ten words against the clock using hints, streaks, and reshuffles to beat the target score.

title: Darts 501
desc: Play real 501 darts: start at 501, three darts a turn, bust rules, and check out on a double.

title: Bowling
desc: Roll ten frames of ten-pin bowling with real strike and spare scoring and a three-ball tenth frame.

title: Mahjong Lite
desc: Clear the four-layer tile solitaire by matching free pairs against the clock with hints and scoring.
